pieces.name: main
pieces.notes: long hip body, ridge NE-SW, hipped both ends; the N apex of the trace is the NE hip end

pieces.name: east_wing
pieces.notes: narrower extension continuing the main ridge to the E corner, lower; a white car parks SE of it

pieces.name: sw_wing
pieces.notes: SW block, ridge parallel to main, hipped at the S corner; overlaps main at its NE end

notes: House rotated 45 deg. Three hip blocks all ridged along the NE-SW axis: main, a narrower east extension, and a SW wing. Trace is too big on the SE and at the W corner, excluded. Confidence medium: inner-corner detail (small dark square by the patio) unresolved.
